title: Zymo-Seq RiboFree Total RNA Library Prep Select-a-Size MagBead Clean-up
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Mix reagents and load temperature module
steps.instruction: Thoroughly mix all reagent tubes by flicking or pipetting, briefly spin down each tube, and place the tubes onto the Opentrons Temperature Module GEN2 as indicated in the Setup section.

substeps.instruction: Flick or pipette each reagent tube to ensure homogeneity.
Briefly spin down the tubes to collect liquid at the bottom.
Load the tubes onto the Temperature Module GEN2 according to the provided layout.

steps.title: Set up deck according to deck map
steps.instruction: Arrange the labware on the OT‑2 deck exactly as shown in the deck map: NEST 96‑well PCR plate (full skirt), 12‑channel reservoir (15 mL) in slot 2, 20 µL and 50/300 µL tip racks, and the Opentrons Magnetic Module GEN2.

steps.title: Enter run parameters on OT‑2
steps.instruction: In the protocol interface, input the number of samples to process, select the cleanup stage (Select‑a‑Size MagBead Clean‑up), and specify the mount sides for the P10 and P300 GEN1 multi‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Download, upload and start protocol
steps.instruction: Click “Download your protocol”, then upload the downloaded file into the OT App, confirm the deck layout, and press “Run”.

steps.title: Replace tip racks when prompted
steps.instruction: When the robot prompts (after processing more than 76 samples), replace the used tip racks with fresh 20 µL or 50/300 µL tip racks before continuing.
